title_id: Pertumbuhan Ekonomi Indonesia 2005-2022 dan GNI Per Kapita
title_en: Indonesia's Economic Growth 2005-2022 and GNI per Capita
labels_id: GNI per kapita naik menjadi ± 6,5x lipat dalam 2 dekade terakhir (2001—2022)

gni_per_capita_usd.note: area chart 2001-2022; y-axis 700-5200; only endpoints labelled; roughly 6.5x increase

gdp_growth_pct_yoy.note: line chart; growth mostly 4-6.5% through 2019, dips to ~4.6% in 2009, falls to about -2.1% in 2020 (COVID-19), recovers to 3.7% in 2021 and 5.31% in 2022

visual_description_en: Two panels. Left: dark-blue area chart of GNI per capita (US$) from 710 in 2001 to 4,580 in 2022, with callout 'GNI per capita rose about 6.5x in the last two decades (2001-2022)'. Right: line chart of annual GDP growth (% yoy) 2001-2022 on a -3 to 7 axis: stable around 5-6% for most of the period, sharp V-shaped dip to about -2 in 2020, back to 5.31 in 2022.
visual_description_id: Dua panel. Kiri: grafik area GNI per kapita (US$) dari 710 (2001) menjadi 4.580 (2022), dengan keterangan 'GNI per kapita naik menjadi ± 6,5x lipat dalam 2 dekade terakhir'. Kanan: grafik garis pertumbuhan ekonomi tahunan (persen yoy) 2001-2022, relatif stabil 5-6 persen, turun tajam ke sekitar -2 pada 2020, kembali 5,31 pada 2022.
summary_en: GNI per capita rose ~6.5-fold from US$710 (2001) to US$4,580 (2022) while annual GDP growth stayed around 5% except for the 2009 dip and the 2020 COVID-19 contraction; growth was 5.31% in 2022.

title_id: Struktur Ekonomi dan Struktur Tenaga Kerja
visual_description_en: Two side-by-side tables with arrows from 2005 to 2022. Left: share of GDP by sector; right: share of total employment by sector. Manufacturing's GDP share fell from 27.4% to 18.3% while 'other' rose from 19.2% to 27.6%; agriculture's employment share fell from 44.0% to 28.6% and services rose from 37.3% to 49.2%.
visual_description_id: Dua tabel berdampingan dengan panah 2005→2022: struktur ekonomi (% PDB) dan struktur ketenagakerjaan (% total tenaga kerja) untuk pertanian, manufaktur, jasa-jasa, dan lainnya.
summary_en: Between 2005 and 2022 manufacturing's share of GDP shrank from 27.4% to 18.3% (premature deindustrialisation signal), services held ~41%, while employment shifted from agriculture (44.0%→28.6%) to services (37.3%→49.2%); manufacturing employment barely rose (12.7%→14.2%).

title_id: Kemiskinan dan Ketimpangan Menurun
visual_description_en: Line chart 2005-2022 with two series: poverty rate (blue, from 15.97 to 9.57, peak 17.75 in 2006, COVID bump 10.19 in 2020) and open unemployment rate (orange, from 11.24 to 5.86, COVID bump 7.07 in 2020). Inset callouts: Gini ratio 0.414 (2014) → 0.381 (2022); GDP contribution KBI 83% → 79.4%, KTI 17% → 20.6%.
visual_description_id: Grafik garis 2005-2022: angka kemiskinan (persen) dan tingkat pengangguran terbuka (persen), dengan sisipan rasio Gini 2014→2022 dan kontribusi KBI/KTI terhadap PDB 2014→2022.
summary_en: Poverty fell from 15.97% (2005) to 9.57% (2022) and open unemployment from 11.24% to 5.86%, both with a temporary COVID-19 rise in 2020; the Gini ratio improved from 0.414 (2014) to 0.381 (2022) and eastern Indonesia's (KTI) GDP share rose from 17% to 20.6%.

summary_en: The Environmental Quality Index rose from 59.79 in 2009 to 72.42 in 2022, with notable volatility (68.31 in 2015, 65.14 in 2018) before a steady climb after 2019; the body text cites the 2009→2022 improvement as evidence of environmental recovery.

title_id: Produksi Padi dan Perikanan 2005-2022

structured_data.note: Area chart without printed data labels; values are visual estimates. The apparent drop in rice output 2014→2019 reflects the 2018 BPS methodology change (KSA) for rice statistics, not stated on the chart.

visual_description_en: Dual-axis area chart 2005-2022. Blue area = rice production (million tonnes of dry unhusked paddy, GKG): rises from ~54 in 2005 to a plateau of ~70 around 2014, then steps down to ~55 from 2019 and stays flat to 2022. Orange area = fisheries production (million tonnes): climbs from ~7 in 2005 to ~21 in 2014 and ~24-25 in 2019-2022. No data labels printed.
visual_description_id: Grafik area dua sumbu 2005-2022: produksi padi (juta ton GKG) naik dari ~54 ke puncak ~70 (2014) lalu turun ke ~55 (2019-2022); produksi perikanan (juta ton) naik dari ~7 ke ~24-25. Tanpa label angka.
summary_en: Rice production (GKG) grew to around 70 million tonnes by 2014 and then settled at roughly 55 million tonnes in 2019-2022, while fisheries production more than tripled from about 7 to about 24 million tonnes between 2005 and 2022.
